Gideon / Emma — thanks for looping me in. A few clarifications and proposed edits from Redwood legal: 

1) Transfers: Redwood offers SCCs incorporated into our DPA by default for EU customers. For customers requiring additional assurances we provide a Transfer Impact Assessment summary and can include an SCCs addendum. We'll include a short TIA summary as an appendix.

2) Subprocessors: We restrict subprocessors to core inference infra, telemetry for operational health, and a limited set of managed services (monitoring, logging). We do not share customer input with analytics vendors by default. We are open to carving out approval rights for Helix on any new subprocessor that would process customer content beyond inference.

3) Redlines: Attached is a marked-up DPA that narrows the subprocessor clause and adds a 30-day notice requirement for new subprocessors for the pilot. We also softened the indemnity reciprocity language per enterprise practice.

4) DocuSign: once Helix confirms the redlines we will prepare a DocuSign envelope. I am happy to accept tracked comments in PDF.

A few asks for Helix legal: please confirm required signing authority (individual name / role) and whether you need SOC 2 Type II evidence or a copy of our latest audit report.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Marissa / Soojin — thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed the redlines and the subprocessor roster. A couple of final points before we sign: 

- Helix will accept the 30-day notice for new subprocessors for the pilot, provided Redwood agrees to an exception for emergency security responders (48-hour notice and retrofit notice).
- Please share the short TIA appendix you mentioned and a copy of your SOC 2 Type II report or at minimum a SOC 2 summary report (audit firm redacted is fine).
- Once we have the TIA and SOC2 summary we'll run this by Helix's CISO. If all good, I will execute via DocuSign — Emma, please confirm the signer (likely our Head of Ops).

I will upload our signature-ready comments to the DocuSign link when we are ready: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/0a1b2c3d-helix-dpa
